content.content: Please create a new 1 hour long event 'Follow-up meeting' on 2024-05-19 at 10:00 or at 16:00 if at 10:00 I already have something. The description should be 'Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.'.

```python
# First, let's check the calendar for May 19, 2024, to see if there are any conflicts at 10:00.
events = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-19")

start_time = "2024-05-19 10:00"
end_time = "2024-05-19 11:00"

# Check for conflicts between 10:00 and 11:00
has_conflict = False
for event in events:
    # Parse times to compare
    event_start = event.start_time
    event_end = event.end_time
    
    # Check if the proposed slot (10:00-11:00) overlaps with the existing event
    # Overlap condition: Start < Existing End AND Existing Start < End
    if start_time < event_end.isoformat() and event_start.isoformat() < end_time:
        has_conflict = True
        break

if has_conflict:
    start_time = "2024-05-19 16:00"
    end_time = "2024-05-19 17:00"

# Create the event
event = create_calendar_event(
    title="Follow-up meeting",
    start_time=start_time,
    end_time=end_time,
    description="Follow-up meeting to discuss the project.",
    participants=None,
    location=None
)
print(f"Event created: {event}")
```
